purpose: Turn the existing ECDLP evidence and decision control plane into a bounded generation, selection, and memory loop that creates source-grounded research seeds, adversarially compiles proposals, ranks admissible candidates, validates runs, and retains outcomes without weakening the promotion gate.

target_contract.selection_rule: A candidate outside the primary threat model is rejected before any information-gain or cost score is computed.
target_contract.claim_boundary: Exploration may reduce uncertainty about a mechanism on bounded toy instances; it cannot by itself establish an asymptotic improvement or a secp256k1 break.

candidate_intake_contract.authorization_rule: The frozen v0 candidates may not be edited into admissibility. A future executable candidate must be compiled deterministically from a typed evidence cell and a digest-bound, quality-cleared proposal; until that compiler exists, generated seeds and proposals authorize nothing.

ecdlp_research.objective: Reduce uncertainty about the plain single-target secp256k1 ECDLP boundary without changing the threat model.
kpis: negative results retained with reopening conditions

keyai_product.objective: Validate whether external formal-research teams need and can use the KeyAI control plane.

anti_conflation_rules: Product traffic, site work, pilots, and portability rehearsals never count as ECDLP progress.
Lean theorem volume never counts as cryptanalytic progress without a route-level uncertainty it resolves.
Toy measurements never count as secp256k1 progress without a mechanism and scaling bridge.
ECDLP experiments never count as product validation.

gap_taxonomy.definition: Relevant work exists but is not yet represented in the evidence graph.
The mathematical result is known, but the repository has not formalized it.
Formalization is blocked by missing prover or library infrastructure.
The mathematical question is open, but no exact complexity-changing mechanism is specified.
An open question has an exact mechanism, a falsifiable prediction, and a plausible path to changing the ECDLP cost model.

outcome_taxonomy.definition: A formal statement was accepted by its declared proof kernel or deterministic logical verifier. Positive toy measurements are never labelled proved.

A preregistered native positive empirical prediction survived the tested scope, raw-artifact recomputation, and reviewed source independence. This is not a proof, asymptotic result, route promotion, or secp256k1 claim.

A migrated historical observation confirms a known structural identity in its recorded scope, but was not preregistered as a native Engine prediction. It is excluded from calibration, dependency unlocking, and route-review triggers.
A preregistered prediction failed under the declared scope and independent validation.
The tested mechanism produced no claimed advantage in a bounded scope; this is not a general impossibility result.
The route or result changes the target, threat model, input promises, or required structure and therefore does not answer the declared question.
The run completed but did not distinguish the competing explanations or its decisive measurement was not independently validated.
The preregistered resource bound was reached before the prediction could be evaluated.

exploration.scope: Bounded toy-curve or verifier-calibration work only.
required: an exact mechanism or a named validator prerequisite for a mechanism-bearing candidate
a falsifiable prediction
a matched baseline
a fixed compute and memory budget
a preregistered stop condition
an independent validator for the decisive claim
a source-commit-bound pure validator that recomputes the decisive classification from raw artifacts under python-pure-json-v3 capability restrictions
an exhaustive preregistered instance-outcome taxonomy and deterministic aggregate precedence, so the terminal label is engine-derived rather than researcher-selected
toy-only target scope
a prohibition on secp256k1-break and asymptotic claims
an outcome event retained for every terminal result

promotion.scope: Route promotion, expensive scaling, exact-target work, or a public complexity claim.
required: exact non-generic mechanism
plain single-target threat-model match
full online, offline, memory, parallelism, and amortization cost model
scaling evidence across multiple sizes
no hidden preprocessing or conditioned inputs
independent reproduction
dated route-selection decision
matching task and hypothesis promotion
disclosure review before any credible exact-target operational work

selection_value.admissibility: Hard gates are boolean and evaluated before ranking; a failed gate cannot be compensated by a score.
selection_value.information_gain_formula: H(prior_live) - sum_o P(o) * H(P(live | o)), in bits
selection_value.commitment: Each selected candidate freezes a latent question, prior, rationale, and P(outcome | live/dead) before its first native run. A generated proposer may not supply the final prior or likelihoods for its own candidate; those values require separate decision-owner review and later native calibration.
selection_value.calibration: Brier scores begin with native preregistered outcomes. Historical migrations are excluded because assigning probabilities after seeing their results would be post hoc.

hypothesis_normalization.rationale: The scoped operational claim is accepted by deterministic repository gates.
hypothesis_normalization.reopening_condition: A consistency regression or an unowned canonical surface appears.

hypothesis_normalization.rationale: The subgroup and whole-group claims are separated at the exact proved scope.
hypothesis_normalization.reopening_condition: A new theorem changes the whole-group or subgroup boundary.

hypothesis_normalization.verifier_scope: Lean generic-model results plus public-scope checks.
hypothesis_normalization.rationale: The generic-model boundary is explicit and mechanically protected from unconditional overclaim.
hypothesis_normalization.reopening_condition: A stronger adaptive generic theorem or a scope regression is introduced.

hypothesis_normalization.rationale: Corpus and theorem denominators are separated in canonical views.
hypothesis_normalization.reopening_condition: A public or machine-readable view conflates the denominators.

hypothesis_normalization.rationale: The lifecycle record is superseded and is not an independent scientific outcome; its unresolved content is retained by HYP_GLV_SEMAEV_001.
hypothesis_normalization.reopening_condition: Never reopen this id; create or update a non-superseded hypothesis instead.

hypothesis_normalization.verifier_scope: No final publication artifact has been independently reviewed.
hypothesis_normalization.rationale: Publication packaging is valuable but does not reduce cryptanalytic uncertainty.
hypothesis_normalization.reopening_condition: A stable engine checkpoint and independent review packet are available.

hypothesis_normalization.rationale: The existing control plane is accepted; Research Engine v0 extends rather than replaces it.
hypothesis_normalization.reopening_condition: A route, hypothesis, or experiment can bypass the declared gates.

hypothesis_normalization.verifier_scope: P0-P4 retain scoped historical measurements. The new finite certificate independently replays the coordinatewise-cube over-quotient obstruction; the general algebra is not kernel-checked.
hypothesis_normalization.rationale: The proposed u_i=X_i^3 construction quotients by C3^m rather than the diagonal C3 action and loses relative phase. The correct finite orbit offers only fixed-cardinality compression; no replacement complexity-changing mechanism is currently specified.
hypothesis_normalization.reopening_condition: A new candidate supplies a materially different exact mechanism, handles the fixed-target fiber explicitly, predicts a growth-relevant effect beyond orbit cardinality, and includes an independent raw-artifact validator.

hypothesis_normalization.verifier_scope: The exact TASK-026 singleton is bound by the decision substrate to the committed readiness package, three synthetic E_7 toy subgroups, thirty frozen cells, independent replay, and fixed resource limits. No terminal scientific outcome exists yet.
hypothesis_normalization.rationale: This enabling test is authorized once by the decision substrate outside the frozen Research Engine v0.2 candidate queue. It tests fixed-target availability of the TASK-025 regular affine locus on the canonical Petit-composed-map cell. The GLV-orbit arm is a matched ablation, not a second route binding; the test does not reopen the rejected coordinatewise-cube quotient, select a native Engine candidate, or promote an attack route.
hypothesis_normalization.reopening_condition: After the exact singleton reaches a validated terminal state, retain that outcome and follow only its preregistered next step; any rerun, solver-slope test, changed threshold, new curve, or larger budget requires a new hypothesis id or dated authorization.

hypothesis_normalization.verifier_scope: Toy-curve EDS torsion identities independently replayed with elliptic-curve arithmetic; no attack-advantage prediction was tested.
hypothesis_normalization.rationale: The bounded run supports the known torsion identity. It neither tests nor supplies a non-reencoding DLP mechanism, so the broader research hypothesis remains inconclusive and closed at intake.
hypothesis_normalization.reopening_condition: A proposal specifies a new operation on EDS data with a justified cost below finding the discrete logarithm directly.

candidate_proposals.title: Retain external-solver calibration as technical debt, not a research candidate
candidate_proposals.mechanism: An external F4/Groebner replay could calibrate the historical P3 proxy, but its only declared downstream coordinatewise-cube candidate is now closed by an exact algebraic obstruction.
candidate_proposals.prediction: No standalone scientific prediction remains. Reintroduce this calibration only when a materially new mechanism names the proxy metric as a decision-critical dependency.
candidate_proposals.baseline: The committed P3 plain and redundant U=X^3 systems remain historical evidence with their existing validator boundary.
candidate_proposals.stop_condition: Do not spend exploration budget calibrating an orphaned proxy. Preserve the frozen draft and reopen under a new candidate id only for a live downstream mechanism.
candidate_proposals.validator: Not implemented. This remains explicit engineering debt and cannot produce or unlock a scientific outcome.

candidate_proposals.title: Close the coordinatewise-cube quotient premise
candidate_proposals.mechanism: The relevant GLV action on relation variables is diagonal C3. Its polynomial invariant ring is the third Veronese subring, generated by all total-degree-three monomials. The proposed coordinates u_i=X_i^3 instead quotient by C3^m and generically merge 3^(m-1) distinct diagonal orbits, losing relative phase.
candidate_proposals.prediction: Resolved without an attack run: at m=2 the coordinatewise same-cube condition contains exactly three diagonal-action graphs on the free locus. The frozen F_1009 witness records 483 pairs on one graph and 1449 same-cube pairs.
candidate_proposals.baseline: Compare the exact diagonal C3 quotient with the larger coordinatewise C3^m quotient, including target-fiber behavior.
candidate_proposals.stop_condition: Closed for this premise. Do not relabel coordinatewise cubes as the diagonal quotient or infer a scaling gain from fixed orbit size.
candidate_proposals.validator: experiments/glv_diagonal_obstruction/validate.py independently recomputes the raw finite witness and toric exponent identities. The general invariant-ring statement is documented, not a Lean kernel theorem.

scope.curve_family: toy j=0 curve E: y^2=x^3+11 over F_1009

candidate_proposals.title: Close scaling of the invalid coordinatewise quotient
candidate_proposals.mechanism: The dependent m=3 proposal has no valid quotient to scale. Coordinatewise cubes over-quotient by a factor of 3^(m-1), while the actual diagonal symmetry has fixed order 3. This rules out the declared orbit-compression premise, not every possible algebraic or Groebner mechanism.
candidate_proposals.prediction: Withdrawn before execution. A fixed finite orbit cannot by itself supply a size-dependent compression factor; any future scaling candidate must introduce and justify a different mechanism.
candidate_proposals.baseline: The historical P1-m3 and P3 measurements remain scoped evidence; they are not promoted into a general Groebner no-go.
candidate_proposals.stop_condition: Do not execute the frozen m=3 draft. Reopen under a new id only with an exact fixed-target construction, recovery map, growth-relevant prediction, and independent raw-artifact validator.
candidate_proposals.validator: The finite diagonal obstruction is independently replayable. No validator exists for a replacement m=3 mechanism because none has been specified.

candidate_proposals.title: Search EDS zeros for a discrete logarithm
candidate_proposals.mechanism: No operation cheaper than finding the discrete logarithm is specified.
candidate_proposals.prediction: None beyond the already known torsion equivalence.

candidate_proposals.title: Run an unscaled candidate directly on secp256k1
candidate_proposals.mechanism: No validated toy scaling bridge is supplied.

candidate_proposals.title: Amortize reusable precomputation across many targets
candidate_proposals.mechanism: Build target-independent tables once and amortize them across a large batch of related ECDLP targets.
candidate_proposals.prediction: Per-target online work drops sharply when the offline table and target batch are excluded from the plain single-target cost.
candidate_proposals.baseline: One arbitrary plain target with all preprocessing, memory, and amortization charged.
candidate_proposals.stop_condition: Reject before scoring because the proposal changes the declared threat model and hides reusable preprocessing from the target cost.
candidate_proposals.validator: Mechanical comparison against the canonical primary threat model.

information_model.latent_question: Would reusable multi-target preprocessing produce a strong measured gain under its own conditioned model?
information_model.prior_rationale: This deliberately attractive, low-cost canary exists to prove that threat-model admissibility dominates ranking.

retrospective_method.claim: The current admissibility gates reject reopening four retained historical cases without a materially new premise, while binding each case to its actual outcome event.
retrospective_method.limitation: Historical runs predate preregistered priors and likelihoods. They test false reopening only and are excluded from predictive calibration; calibration starts with the first native Engine outcome.

historical_scope_guards.curve_family: ambient-group toy j=0 curve with cofactor 3

generated_updates: digest-bound proposal and adversarial review state
feedback_contract.promotion_boundary: Generated evidence may close, park, or reopen exploration candidates. It may not promote a route, authorize exact-target work, or make a public complexity claim without a dated decision-substrate change.
required_after_every_terminal_run: bind a native outcome to a hashed run envelope, full candidate policy, exact preregistration matrix prefix, candidate-run manifest, and per-instance result/validation records with validator code hashes
run the engine and decision validators
regenerate the knowledge graph and public views
retain negative, inconclusive, and resource-exhausted results
